name: B站收藏夹列表
description: 列出B站登录用户收藏夹中的视频，返回指定条数（默认 30，最多 100；滚动加载）。需要B站登录态。

inputs.name: mid
inputs.description: B站用户 mid；不填则用当前登录账号

body.name: open_tab
body.note: 先落 www 域（拿登录 mid）

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));let mid=want('$mid');if(!mid){let navr=null;for(let att=0;att<3&&!navr;att++){try{const r=await fetch('https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav',{credentials:'include'}).then(x=>x.json());if(r.data&&r.data.mid)navr=String(r.data.mid);}catch{await sleep(800);}}mid=navr||'';}if(!mid)return {ok:false,error:'no-login',hint:'未获取到登录 mid（收藏夹需要B站登录态）'};if(location.href.indexOf('/'+mid+'/favlist')<0){location.href='https://space.bilibili.com/'+mid+'/favlist';const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!/favlist/.test(location.href))await sleep(400);}await sleep(2500);const lim=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$limit'))||30,100));const collect=()=>{const byUrl=new Map();for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/video/BV"]')){const m=(a.getAttribute('href')||'').match(/BV[0-9A-Za-z]+/);if(!m)continue;const url='https://www.bilibili.com/video/'+m[0];const t=(a.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const prev=byUrl.get(url);if(!prev||t.length>prev.title.length)byUrl.set(url,{title:t.slice(0,120),bvid:m[0],url:url});}return byUrl;};let byUrl=collect();const maxRounds=Math.max(4,Math.min(20,Math.ceil(lim/10)+3));for(let i=0;i<maxRounds&&byUrl.size<lim;i++){const before=byUrl.size;for(let y=0;y<=document.body.scrollHeight;y+=700){window.scrollTo(0,y);await sleep(150);}await sleep(900+Math.floor(Math.random()*300));byUrl=collect();if(byUrl.size>=lim)break;if(byUrl.size===before&&i>1)break;}window.scrollTo(0,0);await sleep(400);return {ok:true,mid:mid,count:byUrl.size,videos:[...byUrl.values()].slice(0,lim)};})()

body.note: 导航到收藏夹页 → 滚动懒加载 → 按 BV 去重提取
